question: Does retained supported overlap contain a closed, robust compatibility corridor around the protected interior? No heights or terrain products change.
levelRationale: Compare unchanged unencoded Swiss-derived parents with decoded common delivery at the identical XYZ cell centres and level. z13 is the common information-bearing delivery ceiling; z12 tests one coarser level. Neither is measurement accuracy. Quantization asymmetry is <=1/512 m and explicitly reported.
heightPolicy: Native LN02 Swiss and EGM2008 common. No datum diagnostic applied, fitted offset, registration, blend or height smoothing.
topology: Four-neighbour planar grid graph at DEM cell centres. A candidate must contain a simple closed graph cycle enclosing the whole protected circle. Threshold edges join two permitted nodes. Flood the dual faces from the protected interior: escape to the outer face proves no enclosing candidate cycle; separation certifies a closed cycle. No prescribed rectangular or star-shaped ring.

protectedInterior.nodeGuard: At least one local cell diagonal beyond radius; graph edges cannot cut the protected circle.

hardConstraints.support: Swiss count exactly 4^(14-z), finite common tile/cell, no partial Swiss means treated as complete heights.
hardConstraints.change: Retained union SGI1973/2016/2023 glaciers with 250 m buffer; WorldCover nearest diagnostic water/snow-ice classes excluded. Masks conservatively resampled with maximum, not terrain heights.
hardConstraints.waterLimit: Retained 25 m nearest WorldCover classification is a diagnostic exclusion, not complete shoreline validation.
hardConstraints.slope: No hard slope cutoff; 5-40 degree stable-fit screen is not automatically a seam mask.

cost: No weighted composite score. Primary feasibility minimizes the maximum endpoint absolute disagreement admitted for a closed cycle. At a few physical thresholds retain the reachable-face boundary and eligible region as witnesses/corridors, not globally shortest or final seamlines. Report route length, integrated disagreement and worst segments independently.
minimumThreshold: Binary search sorted finite eligible-node absolute differences, with exact below/at witnesses. Hard-domain failure is reported as no finite threshold, not repaired by scoring.
sensitivity: SGI glacier buffers 100/250/500 m from retained official inventory assets
strict candidate-stable support as a separately labelled domain
glacier/snow exclusion disabled only as a scientifically invalid obstruction control, never accepted corridor
rectangleControl: Nearest full-supported graph-cell strip to the original 10x10 km LV95 source rectangle, with explicit footprint/sample offset, excluded fractions and zero remaining collar; compare with candidate witnesses if any.
supportMetrics: Distance to protected circle and source edge, common-root edge; clearance to exclusions, stable support nearby. No future transition width assumed.
outputs: Immutable external diagnostic fields, topology witnesses, optional closed routes, maps and hash manifest; lightweight protocol/results and pure synthetic graph tests in Git. No renderer stream or DEM output.
stopping: One two-level diagnostic. Do not relax hard constraints into a success, acquire more terrain, construct a seam/transition, or perform follow-on work.
obstructionAttributionAddendum: After the first topology pass found no admissible cycle, separate glacier-only and snow-only exclusion ablations identify which class independently blocks closure. These are obstruction controls, not relaxed candidate corridors. No scoring or heights change.
